definition_vi: Thieu nguon luc nhu ngan sach va nhan su de thuc hien bao mat

Bao mat khong duoc xem la nhiem vu cua ban than
Bao mat duoc xem la trach nhiem cua bo phan khac
Moi truong lam viec khien lap trinh vien thu dong voi bao mat
Khong nhan thay nguy co bi ton that hoac chiu hau qua
Khong cho rang cong ty hoac ung dung la muc tieu tan cong
Cac cong viec khac duoc uu tien hon bao mat
Khong san sang thay doi cong nghe hoac cach lam hien tai
